qualification: union same-user/channel/item/airing overlap fragments; cap at airing duration; >=0.8; complete views and airings before cutoff; no absolute-second floor
target: five most frequent qualifying programme IDs; ascending-ID frequency ties locally; local AP treats top-five target as set

opportunity.schedule_columns: ID/channel/start/duration only; distinct complete labelled airings

implicit_mf.weight: log1p qualified counts as confidence on binary preference

confidence.applies_to: all personal terms including MF; global popularity unchanged

fallback: no qualified history or zero/nonfinite score -> training-only all60 distinct-user popularity
excluded: Poisson extension rejected by predeclared threshold; personalized channel factor rejected
